column1: # name:        the case name, which is also the ktest kernel name
# stage:       the laboratory stage that supplies the mechanisms
# source:      the case source file, relative to the tree root
# assertions:  the number of assertions the case must print per boot
# boots:       the number of QEMU boots that share one disk image copy
# fault:       a PANIC pattern for a negative case, or "-" for a positive case
# input:       a console input fixture, relative to the tree root, or "-"
# make test STAGE=N runs every case whose stage is at most N.
